overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the post-meeting conversation between the chair and a member concerned only a personal matter. The broader allegation of regular deliberations from 2012 to 2017 was declined for lack of a prior complaint to the board.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the chair and a board member discussed board business after a posted August 10 meeting, outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Absent sufficient evident to the contrary, we credit the Board's account of the facts and find that it did not discuss Board business outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board regularly deliberates outside posted meetings, citing examples from 2012 to 2017, which was not in the original August 11 complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation because we find that it was not included within the August 11 complaint to the Board and the Board has not had an opportunity to respond to it.
